summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built and integrated C++ and Python software across a three-layer voice-controlled robotic arm system, resolving 11 integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials). Wrote CUDA C++ kernels for a ~35% speedup and Cython-accelerated Python tokenization for a 4–5.5× speedup.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing, plus dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over an I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking for multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote administration.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.
